name: Structured
one_liner: Structured is a visual day planner that puts tasks, events and routines on one timeline, popular with people who have ADHD.
best_for: Adults with ADHD who struggle with lists
not_for: People looking for ADHD diagnosis or treatment
short_description: Structured is a visual day planner that puts tasks, events and routines on one timeline, popular with people who have ADHD.
long_description: Structured is a visual day planner that puts tasks, events and routines on one timeline, popular with people who have ADHD. See your day as a timeline instead of a list, drag tasks into place, and use the focus timer and widgets to stay on track. The core planner is free; Pro adds calendar sync, recurring routines and automatic replanning of missed tasks. What it includes: Visual daily timeline; Inbox for quick capture; Focus timer and widgets; Pro: calendar sync and routines.

faqs.a: Free; Pro about $9.99–$49.99/year or $99.99 lifetime. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Structured before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Structured replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Structured is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Structured is available on iPhone and Android.
